notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.1 public-API witness for the Model Identification Name criterion at p. 91 l. 54. The case submits a schema-valid FOM whose Model Identification Name uses a nonempty HLA/XML-compatible name through public Create and verifies the federation can be destroyed. Evidence covers only acceptance of this conforming-name path; it does not claim rejection of every malformed spelling or full Model Identification table validation.
